bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education finance; appropriating money for a grant to Girl Scouts River Valleys.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; GIRL SCOUTS RIVER VALLEYS.

Subdivision 1.

Department of Education.

The sums indicated in this section are appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education for the fiscal years designated.

Subd. 2.

Girl Scouts River Valleys.

(a) For a grant to Girl Scouts River Valleys leadership institute:

$

500,000

.....

2026

$

500,000

.....

2027

(b) The grant recipient must use grant money to support activities of the Girl Scouts River Valleys leadership institute, including but not limited to programming on healthy relationships; science, technology, engineering, and math; financial literacy; college and career readiness; leadership development; service learning; or providing internships.

(c) This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: The sums indicated in this section are appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education for the fiscal years designated.
(a) For a grant to Girl Scouts River Valleys leadership institute:

(b) The grant recipient must use grant money to support activities of the Girl Scouts River Valleys leadership institute, including but not limited to programming on healthy relationships; science, technology, engineering, and math; financial literacy; college and career readiness; leadership development; service learning; or providing internships.
